changelog: Dev build v836. Closes the remaining host crash on the CSM player settings screen. The onResume and preference-change refresh path re-applied a ListPreference summary from the raw option label, so toggling any player modification re-armed the String.format crash for Controls Dim Level ("Medium (30%)" -> UnknownFormatConversionException: Conversion = ')'). Every ListPreference summary assignment now escapes the label; the displayed text is unchanged. Also carries the v835 escape fix, the v834 PACKAGED_ABI probe-classloader fix and the active self-test campaign. This dev build aggregates all current unpublished source in the shared CSM tree and is not an isolated patch.
message: Dev build v836 - close remaining ListPreference summary crash on player settings
